access_links.label: PDOK BAG services (WMS, WFS, OGC API) and product overview

description: The BAG (Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen) is the Dutch government's authoritative register of all buildings and addresses, part of the national system of base registers. Municipalities are the source holders and are responsible for entering data and for its quality; the Kadaster runs the national facility LV-BAG and delivers the data to users. It records every building (pand) with its outline, construction year and status, and every addressable object with its use function and floor area, plus moorings and caravan pitches; building outlines come from aerial photos and terrestrial survey with about 30 centimetre accuracy. Coverage is the whole Netherlands, updated continuously; PDOK's web services are refreshed daily. Access: the BAG API for individual queries, a viewer, the full BAG Extract and a GeoPackage through Atom download services, OGC API vector tiles and features, and WMS and WFS on PDOK; a new BAG Extract download API replaces the SOAP service, which stops on 1 March 2027. Licence: open data under the Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0; free. Caveats: the PDOK WFS carries only main addresses, and building outlines include underground parts. Simulation uses are building exposure, energy and capacity planning, and emergency response. Related records: 3DBAG (3D models built from the BAG) and EUBUCCO (includes it).
